entities.title: Samosa
entities.summary: A clean-room remake of a 1983 ZX Spectrum strategy game for the browser: rule Nicaragua month by month until you are killed or flee, then put the reign on a replay-checked high-score table.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the browser game in src/, the Worker that serves it and keeps the high-score table in worker/, the page in public/, the tests in test/, the contact-sheet renderer in scripts/ and the design documents in docs/. It is one npm project and one Cloudflare Worker. The folder is named dictator; the game, its Worker, its address and its database are named samosa.
boundaries: The rules are docs/RULES.md's; the code follows them and changes no rule.
The faithful baseline the remake was checked against lives in a private repository and is never copied here; test/guard.test.ts keeps only hashes of the original's strings.
The sign-in is icelander.net's; the Worker checks it with the shared library in vendor/icelander-auth/, never edited here.
/games/me, /games/play.js and the sign-in pages under /auth/ are the games hub's, in another repository; this folder only calls them.
